## Owner-word issues labelled `cockpit` count everywhere

COCKPIT now opens its issues with the label **`cockpit`** alone (and with `owner-word` only while a repository has no
`cockpit` label). 0.38.0 already let the owner-word wake routine treat its wake label (default `cockpit`) as an
owner-word issue; this release makes every other reader do the same.

- **WORKFLOW §8.6, `rules/AGENTS.md`, `softure-worktree-manager`, `softure-doctor`, ONBOARD, README.** Coordinators list
  open issues labelled `cockpit` or `owner-word`, and both count as an owner-word issue.
- **Roadmap heartbeat.** Lists both labels as owner-word issues and leaves both out of the issue-mode queue.
- **Package-update routine.** Opens its owner-step issue with `cockpit`.
- **Installer.** Creates both labels, `cockpit` and `owner-word`, when an authenticated `gh` can (outside CI);
  otherwise it prints the command for each.
- The body marker `<!-- owner-word: {...} -->` is unchanged.

Adopting apps: re-run the installer, or create the label once:
`gh label create cockpit --color 5319e7 --description "An owner decision the coordinator acts on (SOFTURE workflow)"`.
